data.title: Add docket release command
data.body:
## Goal

Add a `docket release VERSION` command that automates the full release workflow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket release VERSION` command exists
- [ ] Finds done bugs without a version assigned
- [ ] Assigns VERSION to unreleased done bugs (with confirmation)
- [ ] Warns about bugs missing changelog types
- [ ] Updates version in Cargo.toml
- [ ] Generates changelog via `docket changelog VERSION`
- [ ] Commits changes (jj or git)
- [ ] Creates `vVERSION` tag
- [ ] Pushes commits and tag to remote

## Flags

- `--preview` - Show what would happen without doing it
- `--no-commit` - Stop after changelog generation
- `--no-tag` - Commit but do not tag
- `--no-push` - Tag but do not push

## Context

Currently releasing requires manual steps:
1. Review done bugs and assign version
2. Set changelog types for bugs missing them
3. Update Cargo.toml
4. Run `docket changelog VERSION`
5. Commit, tag, push

This command consolidates the workflow into a single action with sensible defaults and escape hatches.
